feeds.title: Live80sKansasCity Blog
feeds.description: Live '80s Kansas City is a digital entertainment site focused on live event promotion and photography for artists from the 1980s appearing locally and outside the area. It brings together fellow fanatics in the beloved city to relive that eminent decade or discover its glory for the very first time. Live '80s Kansas City concert blog provides reviews of concerts in Kansas City and live events featuring artists from the 1980s performing in the area.

feeds.title: Music Mavericks Blogazine
feeds.description: Where music lives and breathes. Music Mavericks Blogazine strives to bring out honest emotions and spirit in our images. What is real is more extraordinary than any processing techniques, although we can do both. Let us share, inform and keep you posted about various artists, and tours of all genres.

feeds.title: Ambient Light Blog
feeds.description: Ambient Light is your go-to place for New Zealand-based live music news, reviews and interviews, featuring some of the best concert photography you'll find worldwide. Ambient Light is the brainchild of two professional photographers, Doug Peters and Meagan Kerr. Both formally qualified and with many years of industry experience under their belts, Doug and Meagan wanted to provide an outlet for the knowledge and information rattling around in their heads, and so Ambient Light was born.

feeds.title: Dana Zuk Photography Blog
feeds.description: Music enthusiast and photo-fanatic! Snapping compelling musician portraits from smoky pubs to sold out arenas, capturing the life of rock 'n roll is second nature to me. Photographing out of Edmonton, Alberta, Canada, I specialize in portraits of live band performances, and promotional images for local and international touring musicians of all kinds.
